scope: Bounded image-stream recovery in FollowSession; no driver or network changes
permanent_faults_retained: repeated, backwards, invalid or future timestamp
publisher, bond, motion or optional-camera health failure

validation.motion_path_test: Real FollowSession and FollowMotion with generated ROS messages and mocked transport/clock: zero during interruption, resume after fresh frames and stop acknowledgement, no commands after cancellation

limitations: Does not identify or repair the upstream cause of image delays
Single-person controlled scene; recovery does not verify personal identity
Stopped acknowledgement is software telemetry, not a physical braking measurement
prior_physical_observation: User confirmed NAO movement with the preceding version; this is not validation of the new recovery policy
